## Team News

Juventus still have a long absence list, and Kerim Alajbegovic is set to join it on Thursday evening, after picking up a minor thigh problem against Venezia.

Pierre Kalulu and Nico Gonzalez are expected to return from injury this weekend, but Kenan Yildiz, Khephren Thuram, Kamil Grabara and captain Manuel Locatelli are still sidelined. [...] Since that setback, they have beaten Anorthosis Famagusta and drawn 1-1 with city rivals APOEL, with Diony scoring on both occasions. As a result, the Nicosia club are fifth in the Cypriot top flight, five points shy of the summit.

Their domestic title defence may not be going to plan, but Omonia are on track to escape a Europa League group or league phase for the first time to date - albeit potentially via the playoffs.

data.title: Juventus vs. Omonoia Nicosia match preview: Time, TV schedule, and how to watch the Europa League | Black & White & Read
data.content:
- It will be Neto’s first appearance in a Juventus shirt since the Coppa Italia final on May 17, 2017.
- With squad rotation happening and Alajbegović out, Jérémie Boga is expected to start on the left wing.
- Francisco Conceição could also make his return to the starting lineup on Thursday night. It will be his first appearance since injuring his shoulder in the 3-0 loss to Lazio on Oct. 18. [...] - Despite the notable names on the injury list, Spalletti is expected to do some squad rotation ahead of the weekend’s trip to Como.
- One of those names who will benefit from that squad rotation is striker Jeff Ekhator, who Spalletti said will start on Thursday night. (More on the young man who signed from Genoa over the summer in a bit.) [...] No matter who ends up in the starting XI — and we already got a few hints from Spalletti during the pre-match press conference — Juventus has a very good chance of getting another three points in the Europa League and having even more situations to rotate in Europe before the knockout rounds arrive. With so many injuries, it’s hard to know when that chance will come again. So a little squad rotation and some more points in Europe? Yeah, that sounds like a good Thursday night for Juventus to me.
